scope: Add mouse/touch-drag orbit, reset view and bounded zoom while safely parked in the actual garage. Keep vehicle framed and retain readable compact English controls.
Show the actual equipped vehicle, selected cosmetic and real visible upgrade. Reuse authoritative identity/loadout; no parallel showroom inventory, economy or save schema.

Implement preview/apply/cancel; close/cancel restores equipped appearance, Apply is once-only and reload preserves exactly what was applied. Use free already-owned finishes for MVP unless the existing owner explicitly supplies paid-service handling.
Prevent drag/zoom from steering or accelerating; restore focus/input on exit. Do not open shutters, pause jobs, clear wanted state or bypass shelter rules.
Demonstrate one existing gameplay upgrade changing the displayed and driven model. Leave cold-box functionality blocked if unavailable; do not implement refrigeration to satisfy a picture.

completion_criteria.check: From ordinary Lower City driving enter the actual garage, inspect every orbit angle via mouse and touch, reset and test both zoom bounds; no clipping, lost vehicle, control leak or implicit shutter action.
completion_criteria.evidence: Exact-head real-world video, input-event matrix and per-state matched visual pairs

completion_criteria.check: Preview each finish, Cancel, close, apply once and double-click Apply; exit and reload before/after commit boundaries. Displayed and driven skin/module IDs agree; no lost ownership, duplicate charge, new unlock, timer pause or heat reset.
completion_criteria.evidence: Authoritative loadout/save traces, negative controls and repeated/interrupted transaction tests

completion_criteria.check: Equip one already supported cargo module using the existing garage flow; actual geometry changes in viewer and road view and the owning gig system consumes its real capability.
completion_criteria.evidence: Same-camera base/module pairs, existing upgrade/gig contract trace and actual-world drive-out capture

completion_criteria.check: Phone portrait/landscape, mouse and controller close/back/orbit transitions retain legible controls and recover focus; baseline gig/UI/traffic regressions remain unchanged.
completion_criteria.evidence: Named viewport/device interaction logs, exact-head relevant local tests and independently opened frames
